title: Daily pre-shift inspection checklist for a CNC lathe
summary: A neutral daily checklist template for a CNC lathe — generic example data, ready to print or copy.

blocks.title: Before the first chip
blocks.body: Use this as a pre-shift template on a CNC lathe. Example machine: fictional Haas-style 2-axis lathe "Cell B Lathe 2". Replace names and numbers with your site's standards.

blocks.heading: Shift header (example)
blocks.caption: Example data only — swap for your log format.

items.label: Way lube level in band
items.detail: Top up with specified oil only. Note if consumption jumped overnight.

items.label: Chuck pressure / jaws
items.detail: Confirm pressure set for today's workholding; jaws clean and correct for the first job.

items.label: Coolant level and concentration
items.detail: Refractometer or site method. Skim tramp oil if the surface looks like a parking lot.

items.label: Guards, door interlock, e-stop
items.detail: Door open should inhibit cycle start. E-stop drops spindle and axes cleanly.

items.label: Hydraulic / pneumatic (if equipped)
items.detail: No puddles, no low-pressure alarms on power-up.

items.label: Tool magazine / turret
items.detail: No loose inserts on the floor from last shift; verify first-tool offset page matches the setup sheet.

items.label: Chip conveyor / bin
items.detail: Empty enough to survive the shift; clear wrapped chips at the chuck.

items.label: Home / reference return
items.detail: Axes reference without odd noises; soft limits behave.

blocks.title: If any critical item fails
blocks.body: Do not start production to "warm it up." Tag out per site rules, notify maintenance or the lead, and write the defect on the sheet. Example critical: failed door interlock, empty way lube, missing chuck pressure.

blocks.heading: Close the sheet
items: Record any top-ups (oil type and approximate amount).
Note the first job number and tooling page used.
File or scan per your quality system before cutting parts for sale.
